about: The passages in Joel's guides that make the same point: each point has a home (article, section, exact words) and its uses, the passages elsewhere that repeat it, put it in their own words, point to it or differ from it, each with its state, and a point of kind "link" is a section of a post and the links to it. When you edit a passage, run `python3 tools/humanization/depends.py check`: it lists every quote that is no longer found, with the passages to re-read; bring those in line or put them to Joel, then record the new words and state here (`add` registers a new pair, `list --write` makes the page articles/DEPENDS.md). "texts" names the copy each article's quotes are checked in, the one that had the most of them on 2026-11-25: the saved copies of the live posts, since the registered masters are behind the posts (masters: 2 of inner-signal's 50 quotes, 0 of inner-child-therapy's 33, 0 of somatic-therapies' 17; live copies: 50, 33 and 17; nibbana's master has no "Who Gets Reborn?" heading and its saved live text does), so point "texts" at a newer saved copy when there is one, or drop the entry once the master is brought up to its post. Each article's words are read in articles/<id>/LIVE-SECTIONS.json, the text of its live post by section, saved again whenever the post is updated or read back (the registered masters are not the live posts: of the 100 quotes first recorded, 2 were found in the masters and all 100 in the live posts). A heading and the links to it inside one post are kept in that post's SECTION-LINKS.json (tools/humanization/section_links.py); this registry holds what crosses sections or posts.

his_words.words: make sure we have a common reference point for the things that are common, in our github version control system for the articles rigth, or some way to know when one thing changes that another thing is dependent on in same article or diff article.
